title: geum urbanum subvar. orientale
intro: Geum urbanum subvar. orientale, commonly known as Avens, is a plant species belonging to the Rosaceae family, characterized by its yellow flowers and aromatic properties. The health benefits of Avens include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve digestive issues, and exhibit antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions of Avens are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, making it a popular remedy for wound healing and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Avens include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
